diagnosis: The customer rotated their IdP signing certificate, which likely caused a metadata mismatch resulting in assertion errors during SSO login. The issue aligns with known behavior where the service provider metadata must be updated after an IdP certificate rotation.
reply: Thank you for contacting support. Based on your description of the recent identity provider certificate rotation and the resulting assertion errors, this appears to be a metadata mismatch. Please try re-uploading your identity provider metadata and testing sign-in with a single account before re-enforcing SSO for all users. For more details, please refer to our article on SSO metadata mismatches after an identity provider change.
